summary: Align the Cargo and flake PTY pins at 063ff7f9: batched event-log writes, follower delivery, process-group reap fencing and dedicated daemon input

compatibility.detail: PTY advances from the previous main pin to 063ff7f9. Through c3d86d9d, pty#137 publishes `<id>.events.jsonl` in 250 ms batches, with one event-lock hold, one read and one atomic replacement per batch instead of one whole-log rewrite per record, removing the write amplification behind pty#45. Record bytes, order within each writer, the JSONL format and retention are unchanged. A daemon record can reach disk up to 250 ms later, a one-shot record (emit, metadata, tags, exec, gc) can land before daemon records from up to one window earlier, and SIGKILL or the forced exit at the shutdown deadline can lose the open window. Session exit and orderly shutdown flush. pty#161 adds batching tests and docs only. pty#159 disconnects terminal subscribers on close through TerminalHandle in the pty crate, which Smalltalk does not depend on. The c3d86d9d-to-063ff7f9 follow-ups add embedding API documentation (#163), follower delivery from start (#164), process-group kill through a reap fence (#165), macOS substrate test assertions (#167), daemon input on its own thread (#169), removal of cursor_visible from persisted events plus dead-writer temporary-file garbage collection (#172), and conformance divergence declarations (#173). The final 4b823084-to-063ff7f9 delta changes only the conformance TOML, not crate source. Smalltalk reads no pty event log; no Smalltalk database or wire API changes. No Smalltalk caller starts passing publication flags. Unenrolled roots retain JSONL and metadata format compatibility; downgrade requires per-host, per-root absence checks for .publication-revocations and .publication-revocations/v1/root.json. If publication state exists, use a forward fix only; never remove it to permit downgrade.

downtime.detail: No forced restarts; sessions use the selected binary on natural restart.

manual.detail: Do not enroll publication roots until rollout is verified on all target hosts. This dependency-only change does not activate services or modify storage. Matching Cargo and flake pins keep the evaluation-time assertion.

recovery.detail: No Smalltalk recovery change. ST_SKIP_EVIDENCE=1 is used for this dependency-only commit; hosted CI remains the exact-commit release proof.
